rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for fiction as a literary genre.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 tai2 siu2 syut3

rows.note: Use this for a made-up or deliberately untrue account, rather than for the literary genre.

example.english: I don't believe a word of the fiction you just made up.
example.traditional: 你啱啱講嗰啲大話，我一句都唔信。
example.jyutping: nei5 ngaam1 ngaam1 gong2 go2 di1 daai6 waa6 ngo5 jat1 geoi3 dou1 m4 seon3
